t: 龙卷风登陆美国中西部和南部，包括阿肯色州华盛顿县；大圣路易斯、日落山、密苏里州、伊利诺伊州和俄…
te: Tornadoes touch down in midwestern and southern United States, including Washington County, Arkansas; Greater St. Louis…
dz: 龙卷风登陆美国中西部和南部，包括阿肯色州华盛顿县；大圣路易斯、日落山、密苏里州、伊利诺伊州和俄克拉荷马州，凌晨有几场龙卷风。共有 36 场龙卷风袭击，造成 9 人死亡，损失达 1.13 亿美元。
de: Tornadoes touch down in midwestern and southern United States, including Washington County, Arkansas; Greater St. Louis, Sunset Hills, Missouri, Illinois, and Oklahoma, with a few tornadoes in the early hours. A total of 36 tornadoes touched down, resulting in the deaths of nine people and $113 million in damages.
